crossRefs.note: to grant to us that we, being delivered out of the hand of our enemies, should serve him without fear,
in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.
For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry…
For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let’s have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with…
A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer will come on him.
How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.
I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.
Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.
My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments.
You believe that God is one. You do well. The demons also believe, and shudder.
No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.

translations.web: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.
translations.bsb: There is no fear in love, but perfect love drives out fear, because fear involves punishment. The one who fears has not been perfected in love.
translations.kjv: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is ➔ not made perfect in love.
translations.asv: There is no fear in love: but perfect love casteth out fear, because fear hath punishment; and he that feareth is not made perfect in love.
